title: Neat Design
text: Neat Design. We almost always have a bowl of pistachios out in the kitchen. Then next to it, we have a bowl for the shells. This is a neat design that streamlines that. This is supposed to be one unit, but mine arrived as two separate pieces. It looks like they were originally stapled together, but it didn't last during transport. The quality of the individual bowls is nice. I like the bamboo look.
